messages.subject: Bootstrap progress visible?
parts:
Is it possible to mirror the process of boostrapping (i.e. 1/100; 2/100; 2/100 etc.) in the console?
I am trying to run a bootstrapping for latent indirect effects with categorical indicators on an external (high power) server. I have to use the se="bootstrap" argument with the sem function. Currently the server has been running for about 700h for 10.000 bootstraps and did not generate an output till now. I am not sure if we were running into an endless loop or if actually bootstrapping is working and just taking it's time. I tried starting the bootstrap with only 100 draws - this worked with one model but two other are again still running since 3 days. It would be great if there was an option to see the progress in the console.
Best, Elisabeth
